cards.answer: Niente di speciale, resto a casa.
cards.notes: What are you doing tonight? / Nothing special, I'm staying home.
Do you want to come to the cinema? / I'd love to. What time?
What do you do in your free time? / I read a lot and I cook.
Where are you going? / I'm going to the supermarket.
Can you help me? / Of course, what do I need to do?

cards.answer: Sì, ho una fame da lupi.
cards.notes: Are you hungry? / Yes, I'm starving. Literally: a wolf's hunger.

cards.answer: Non del tutto. Puoi spiegare di nuovo?
cards.notes: Do you understand? / Not completely. Can you explain again?
What are you drinking? / A glass of red wine.

cards.prompt: A che ora ti alzi la mattina?
cards.answer: Di solito mi alzo alle sette.
cards.notes: What time do you get up in the morning? / I usually get up at seven.
Can you cook? / Yes, but only simple dishes.
Do you have to work tomorrow? / Yes, unfortunately.

cards.answer: Sì, un attimo, prendo la giacca.
cards.notes: Shall we go? / Yes, just a moment, I'll get my jacket.
